This home boasts two expansive living spaces: a large living room and an equally impressive family room, both featuring French doors that open onto an enclosed backyard patio. This inviting outdoor retreat extends the living space and provides the perfect setting for entertaining guests, enjoying a quiet morning, or unwinding at the end of the day. The stunning kitchen has a large center island, new appliances and offers modern functionality along with a breakfast bar and eat-in dining area.
